notes.title: Exceeded your activation limit?
notes.content:
Unfortunately, Viva Media does not have access to the activation mechanism that is used in the Fritz Chess products we distribute on Steam. However if you send an email to support@playchess.com they can offer assistance with increasing the activation limit on your serial key. 

You can also see more support options here as well: http://en.playchess.com/Home/Support

notes.title: Script Fault Errors in Training Modules
notes.content:
Dear Players,

It has come to our attention that some of you are experiencing issues with using some DLC content packs for Fritz Chess. If you are seeing this happening while trying to access the content, please send a screenshot to Jason.Carver@encore.com with any other information about what you were doing at the time, and I will pass this information onto our QA Team. Sorry for the issues this has caused and thank you for your assistance in helping us get to the bottom of this!

notes.title: Follow-up to incorrect serial keys announcement
notes.content:
Dear Fans.

I hope everyone is enjoying Fritz Chess 14. I am posting this as an update to an earlier post I had put regarding incorrect serial keys that have been distributed through the Steam Client. I've been getting some emails regarding incorrect keys when they are correct. The most common mistake that is being made is that the security characters are not being entered into the box correctly. Also, when the serial key box pops up and you get a notice from your firewall, please don't block it otherwise the activation process won't work correctly.

If you have any questions about this please post in the forums and I would be happy to address them. 

Thank You.

Jason Carver
Community Moderator at Encore Software

notes.title: Deep Fritz Multicore Engine available as DLC now!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We have listened to you! We have closely worked with the creators with Deep Fritz and we are happy to add the multi core version of Fritz Chess as a DLC. For $17.99 (Limited time sale ) you can upgrade your version to a true version of Deep Fritz 14. 

Here is the product description : 

Single-processor engines are a thing of the past – that's why the new Fritz comes as a powerful multi-processor version right from the word “go”. Deep Fritz 14 features a 64-bit engine and can support up to eight processor cores simultaneously.

Thank you all for your feedback , regarding our Fritz 14 game and we are proud to bring this additional content to you.

notes.title: Getting Acitvation key errors? Here is what you need to do.
notes.content:
While I've outlined in the forums on how to deactivate your product, in the event that you get the error that says " key is already used " please visit the Chessbase website at http://en.chessbase.com/support and supply your serial code. Under the game list choose Deep Fritz 14. Explain to them your activation limit has been exceeded and they will look at your issue and extend your activation count on a case by case basis. Remember to use the deactivate button when you plan on reformatting your computer or moving the game to another one 

Thank you,

Jason Carver
Community Support at Encore Software / Viva Media

notes.title: Fritz Chess14 Updates,
notes.content:
Dear Players,

If you get a notification at the bottom right of the screen saying an update is available for the game and if you would like to update it, it's OK to update. The only thing that's being updated by the online component is GUI14.exe

Does not hurt the program. Not sure what the updates from the developer resolves but your free to download it if it shows up :)

Right now I have build 16 of the app.

notes.title: Media Files are available for everyone now!
notes.content:
Dear Fritz Chess Players,

I am happy to annouce that all of you now have our media files for the game (32 and 64 bit) Some of you may have our files already (especially the 64 bit people)

Some of you will see our files under (Documents/My Documents  , Chess Base , and then Shop)

For new installations we are placing the files in the Multimedia Files folder under Chess Base in the My Documents / Documents folder.

This will be for all new installs. 

As always we are listening to your feedback. If you feel there is something that should be improved please do not hesitiate to post about it on the forums or private message /friend me and tell me about it. My user name is IMALITTLEBEAR.

Thank You,

Jason Carver
Community Support at Encore Software / Viva Media

notes.title: All regions should have Fritz 14 Engine Now (32 Bit / 64 Bit)
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you very much for interacting with us in regards to the Fritz 14 Engine being missing. We have resolved the issue and new builds of the games for all regions (32 bit and 64 bit) should now include the missing engine. You will have to remove your old version of the game and redownload the game from Steam in order to get the new build of the game. 

As always we are monitoring your feedback. If you see anything else crop up  please let us know when you are able to and I will pass this onto the QA team for further evaluation.
